description: agent-action under v48, read in permissive mode, exercising http:request(origin=https://api.example.com) without region. Every granted constraint binds, registered or not (§7.4, §7.6), so it is not a sub-scope: verifier MUST reject with E_SCOPE_DENIED.

expected.rejection_reason: Permissive mode accepts a key it does not know; it does not drop it. region=eu is part of the grant, and an exercised scope that leaves it out is wider than the grant.
